name: superb
description: Personal skills for Codex: setup, craft, pipeline, pipeline-auto, fast-pipeline, turbo-pipeline, bug-investigate and bug-fix.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify product ideas, run an implementation pipeline, fix bugs from evidence.
interface.longDescription: setup installs and verifies the dependencies the others need. craft turns a vague product idea into a decision-rich brief. pipeline v2 takes an approved brief through file-backed planning, durable execution state, implementation, review and fixes. pipeline-auto is its autonomous variant: one human gate, then later decisions go to a three-agent quorum that may never overrule a recorded human answer. fast-pipeline is the quick variant: one spec approval, no project tests, and a final review/bug-fix loop. turbo-pipeline is the autonomous quick variant: one batch of at most six questions, then spec, plan, implementation and review run without you, with two independent brains settling any open decision by the higher confidence. bug-investigate traces a reported bug to file:line evidence and stops there, for when knowing is the deliverable. bug-fix carries that same investigation on to a fix that is not done until a regression test which failed first passes.
defaultPrompt: Set up superb and install what it needs.
Help me turn this product idea into a clear brief.
Run the implementation pipeline for this approved design.
Build this fast — one spec approval, no tests, I will test it myself.
Ask me what you need once, then build it without coming back to me.
Find out why this is broken.
Find out why this is broken and fix it.
